probe.name: unique-dupe-foreign
probe.input_setup:
Sub Setup()
Dim f As Object,g As Object
ActiveSheet.Name="Data"
Set f=Range("A1:A4").FormatConditions.AddUniqueValues
f.DupeUnique=0
f.Borders(xlBottom).Color=vbBlue
Set g=Range("A1:A4").FormatConditions.AddUniqueValues
g.DupeUnique=1
g.Borders(xlBottom).Color=vbGreen
f.Priority=9
g.Priority=2
End Sub
probe.source:
Function Cx5P(o As Object,k As String) As String
Dim v As Variant
On Error GoTo Failed
v=CallByName(o,k,VbGet)
If IsNull(v) Then
Cx5P="Null(1)"
ElseIf IsEmpty(v) Then
Cx5P="Empty(0)"
Else
Cx5P=CStr(v) & "(" & VarType(v) & ")"
End If
Exit Function
Failed:
Cx5P="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
End Function
Function Cx5Border(o As Object,k As String) As String
Dim b As Object
On Error GoTo Failed
Set b=o.Borders(xlBottom)
Cx5Border=Cx5P(b,k)
Exit Function
Failed:
Cx5Border="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
End Function
Function Cx5Range(o As Object) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Cx5Range=o.AppliesTo.Address
Exit Function
Failed:
Cx5Range="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
End Function
Function Cx5Inventory() As String
Dim w As Object,s As String
For Each w In Application.Workbooks
s=s & "[" & w.Name & "]"
Next
Cx5Inventory=s & ";active=" & ActiveWorkbook.Name
End Function
Function Cx5Info(o As Object) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Cx5Info="class=" & TypeName(o) & ";range=" & Cx5Range(o) & ";priority=" & Cx5P(o,"Priority") & ";dupe=" & Cx5P(o,"DupeUnique") & ";color=" & Cx5Border(o,"Color") & ";index=" & Cx5Border(o,"ColorIndex")
Exit Function
Failed:
Cx5Info="INFO-ERROR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
End Function
Function Cx5Item(t As Object,n As String,i As Long) As String
Dim f As Object
On Error GoTo Failed
Set f=t.Worksheets(n).Cells.FormatConditions(i)
Cx5Item=Cx5Info(f)
Exit Function
Failed:
Cx5Item="LOOKUP-ERROR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
End Function
Function Cx5Count(t As Object,n As String) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Cx5Count=CStr(t.Worksheets(n).Cells.FormatConditions.Count)
Exit Function
Failed:
Cx5Count="COUNT-ERROR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
End Function
Function Cx5Read(t As Object,n As String,h As Object) As String
Dim s As String,i As Long,stage As String
On Error GoTo Failed
stage="activate"
t.Worksheets(n).Activate
s="active=" & ActiveSheet.Name & ";target=" & t.Name & ";heldCopySecond{" & Cx5Info(h) & "}"
For i=1 To 3
s=s & "|Data" & CStr(i) & "{" & Cx5Item(t,"Data",i) & "}"
Next
For i=1 To 3
s=s & "|Copied" & CStr(i) & "{" & Cx5Item(t,"Copied",i) & "}"
Next
Cx5Read=s & ";DataCount=" & Cx5Count(t,"Data") & ";CopyCount=" & Cx5Count(t,"Copied")
Exit Function
Failed:
Cx5Read="PHASE-ERROR:" & CStr(Err.Number) & ":" & stage & ";partial=" & s
End Function
Function Cx5Probe(t As Object) As String
Dim src As Object,cp As Object,h As Object,held As Object,s As String,stage As String,n As Long,d As String
On Error GoTo Failed
stage="source"
Set src=t.Worksheets("Data")
src.Activate
stage="copy"
src.Copy After:=src
Set cp=Application.ActiveSheet
If cp.Parent.Name<>t.Name Then Err.Raise 5,,"copy target workbook mismatch"
cp.Name="Copied"
cp.Activate
stage="add"
Set h=cp.Range("D20:D22").FormatConditions.AddTop10
h.Rank=3
h.Borders(xlBottom).Color=vbYellow
Set held=cp.Cells.FormatConditions(2)
s="before-copy=[" & Cx5Read(t,"Copied",held) & "];before-original=[" & Cx5Read(t,"Data",held) & "]"

Cx5Probe=s & ";after-copy=[" & Cx5Read(t,"Copied",held) & "];after-original=[" & Cx5Read(t,"Data",held) & "]"
Exit Function
Failed:
n=Err.Number
d=Err.Description
Cx5Probe="PROBE-ERROR:" & CStr(n) & ":" & stage & ":" & d & ";partial=" & s
End Function

Function Cx5Capture() As String
Dim t As Workbook,s As String,stage As String,h As Object,n As Long,d As String
On Error GoTo Failed
stage="open"
s="inventoryBefore=" & Cx5Inventory()
Set t=Workbooks.Open("C:\Users\William\.codex\worktrees\conditional-sheet-copy\pyOpenVBA\.cache\conditional-sheet-copy-child-context-v6-samples\unique-shared-input.xlsm",0,True)
s=s & ";target=" & t.Name & ";props=" & CStr(t.FileFormat) & "|" & CStr(t.HasVBProject)
stage="probe"
s=s & "||RESULT||" & Cx5Probe(t)
stage="final"
Set h=t.Worksheets("Copied").Cells.FormatConditions(1)
s=s & "||FINAL||" & Cx5Read(t,"Data",h)
stage="save"
t.SaveAs "C:\Users\William\.codex\worktrees\conditional-sheet-copy\pyOpenVBA\.cache\conditional-sheet-copy-child-context-v6-samples\unique-dupe-foreign.xlsm",52
t.Close False
stage="reopen"
Set t=Workbooks.Open("C:\Users\William\.codex\worktrees\conditional-sheet-copy\pyOpenVBA\.cache\conditional-sheet-copy-child-context-v6-samples\unique-dupe-foreign.xlsm",0,True)
Set h=t.Worksheets("Copied").Cells.FormatConditions(1)
s=s & "||REOPEN-COPY||" & Cx5Read(t,"Copied",h)
s=s & "||REOPEN-ORIGINAL||" & Cx5Read(t,"Data",h)
t.Close False
Cx5Capture=s & "||INVENTORY-AFTER||" & Cx5Inventory()
Exit Function
Failed:
n=Err.Number
d=Err.Description
On Error Resume Next
t.Close False
Cx5Capture="CAPTURE-ERROR:" & CStr(n) & ":" & stage & ":" & d & "||PARTIAL||" & s & "||INVENTORY-AFTER||" & Cx5Inventory()
End Function
